notes.title: Final Update News
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]

I know this might come as a surprise to many of you. However, some of you are already aware of the [b]numerous issues I've encountered with Construct 3[/b] (the game engine BioGun is made on) in the past, and unfortunately, they have continued to escalate at a rapid pace. Update 1.7.0.0 will be the final update for BioGun until further notice.

Over the past few weeks, it has become increasingly clear that despite my best efforts, Construct 3 is unable to meet our development demands, to the point where I am unable to test bug fixes or add content. These setbacks have massively effected productivity. This update has been completed for the last several days but due to being unable to export successfully because of constant crashes I am now just getting to push it. As you can imagine, this strain prevents us from moving forward with the new content we had in mind until this is resolved by the engine creators. 

For the health of our team and the future of our games, we need to step back from the originally planned alternate ending DLC for the time being and pivot.

[b]Does that mean this is the end for BioGun?[/b]

[b]Absolutely NOT!!!![/b]

We're still committed to pushing forward with the Kickstarter campaign for the console port and are actively exploring other ways to navigate forward.

Our future projects (besides the Kickstarter) aren't fully finalized yet, but we promise to keep you informed every step of the way.

We truly appreciate your continued support, patience, and understanding during this time. Thank you for being part of our community — we’re hopeful to bring good news to share soon.

Wish us luck,
[i]Dapper Dog Digital[/i]

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays everyone![/h1]

We’ve got a small surprise for you all. Alongside working hard on the next big content update for BioGun, set to launch in January, we’ve prepared a little something special for Christmas! :santa::gift:

Here’s what’s new:

[h3][u][b]Cheat System[/b][/u][/h3]
We’ve added a cheat system to make the game more accessible for everyone! You can activate these cheats via the pause menu. However, please note:

[b]Enabling cheats will  disable Steam Achievements for that save file, even if you turn the cheats off later.[/b]

[h3][u][b]Performance Optimization[/b][/u][/h3]
We’ve been working on optimizing the game to improve performance. While we haven’t been able to test it on a wide scale yet, we’ve observed a notable boost on our devices. According to our data, we've cut the games memory in half since Early Access launch with this update! 

[h3][u][b]New Achievements[/b][/u][/h3]
We've added a few more early game achievements to balance out the rate at which you get them. Considering many players first achievement was defeating Roo Caper :Angry_RooCaper: Loading into your file may net you some of them immediately! 

If you’ve experienced performance issues before, we’d love for you to give the game another shot and let us know if these improvements make a difference.


[h3][u][b]Final Thoughts:[/b][/u][/h3]
2024 was a huge year for us and we are grateful to have fostered such an awesome community around BioGun. We thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy this little festive treat! 

Signing off for the year!

Happy Holidays!
~ The BioGun Team

[u][h3][b]For those affected by a black screen when loading into your save file...[/b][/h3][/u]
[i]NOT to be confused with getting a black screen when transitioning between rooms in the game. That is a seperate issue related to storage space on your device.[/i]


I created a beta branch that gives access the the build of BioGun before v1.5 update. To access it, right click BioGun on Steam in your library, go to properties and then select Beta.

Enter the password: BioGunPreVersion

Once you do so, select the drop-down box that says none and select the beta you now have access to.

[b]BEWARE.[/b] I won’t be able to fix the black screen issue so you will be stuck in this version if you want to keep playing your save file. I highly recommend starting a new file in the latest version if you want to receive future updates. I apologize for this inconvenience. I didn't anticipate issues with some save files and we didn't run into this with our playtesters before pushing the update.

After four years of dedication and hard work, BioGun is now ready for you to explore. We have put our hearts and souls into making the game we wanted to play, as always. We are genuinely in love with what it became, and we hope you'll fall in love too! 

We are thankful for a community that is kind and helpful. You guys were very kind and supportive all the way. Knowing people are waiting for the game to come out is something that means a lot to work every day. Now all we need to hear is your review and your feedback.

Join Bek on his journey to save the entire canine species from extinction brought on by the sinister Dooper Virus. notes.title: BioGun | Full Release Date Reveal
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your ongoing support and interest in [b]BioGun[/b]. Our Early Access phase has been greatly impacted by your feedback and enthusiasm and we are pleased to announce that the official release date has been set.

[previewyoutube=htTng9JmZeM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]July 31, 2024[/b] - that's the day when [b]BioGun[/b] will be fully released! We couldn't have done it without all the hard work, passion, and dedication we've put into the game.

We've seen fantastic results and improvements thanks to your feedback during early access, and we're excited to share the polished, complete version with you. We are confident that you will love the final product as much as we do.

[h3]Notes to the community: [/h3]

We have recently begun refactoring all of BioGun's code to minimize CPU usage. Because of this, the bugs fixed above were ones that slipped through the cracks. We are still in the process of refactoring and hope to continue this process to increase performance for the game. So far, 95% of the enemies have been refactored including all bosses. What's left are area specific mechanics and a few other things. We appreciate everyone helping us find bugs as we continue working towards making BioGun one of the most unique Metroidvania experiences among so many incredible releases in 2024.
